snippet.title: Luigi's Mansion: Beyond Origins - NFG 2021 Reveal Trailer (Archive)
snippet.description:
A fan-showcase trailer for a project that, at this point, may have well shaped my early interest for working with programming, machine language and future endeavors in computer science. Maybe occasional art-related work.

It was 2016, and I decided to take matters up my own hands, doing what I could to recreate the Luigi's Mansion E3 demo, at a time a recreation of which was strictly gatekept by those who had some (not all!) of the knowledge to make it real. 
"Luigi's Mix/Collection" was the old, slightly cringey, yet endearing name my young mind could come up with. At least, by the time I was 2 years older than the minimum age for the Internet, I had come up with something sensible.

But after long years of all kinds of limitations, such an idea had turned sour. And I realized that, even with the little that became possible during this time and what I learned of registers, instructions and code through some kind souls, this was one good way to let creativity fairly loose, through a new name and roots.

This was an attempt at unleashing this game's potential through story & gameplay, and what you can probably best describe as an Alternate Universe of today, adapting on top of the mystery surrounding this game's early history. 
What if Luigi had arrived a tad earlier...? The littlest shifts can lead to very different outcomes.
That lore book, though, I'll leave up to your (fairly easy) interpretation. ;)

However, I simply had too many plans for a one-man team. Eventually, I began my commission service, and the rest is history - there was no time or strength for something stretching the limits of ambition. So, if you were looking for this answer, nope, it's not that playable. I didn't make it far enough to fit all the content into a progression line, despite intending to do so.

All in all, though, many of the ideas shown here, despite not being their most stable selves here and there, are food for thought on the many ways this game could've been way more interesting. Maybe one day, I'll cook up a complete showcase of them.

Despite not all of them being revived verbatim in other projects, I have worked on a lot of things in the same spirit. For those who stayed interested up to here, I would be very thankful if you checked out my service, out of which came the recent things I helped build more professionally. I'm always around should you be interested in trading for cool features such as these in your own projects.

Luigi's Mansion Premium Deluxe 2.0 - https://gamebanana.com/mods/625665

At last, I met my original goal:
Luigi's Mansion Beta Restoration Revamped - https://gamebanana.com/mods/625665

Project Reality - https://gamebanana.com/mods/593685

Poltergust Ride - https://gamebanana.com/mods/661656

Mario Kart: Double Dash!! - Retro Track Grand Prix - https://gamebanana.com/mods/594415

And of course, the Nintendo Fan-Games Direct: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PfKRN1Ejbho

Song - "Ice Eyes, Kamoking" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iWWKC6x7qYE

Yes. This project has been sunsetted since 2023.
Regardless - thank you, Beyond Origins, for helping me go beyond mine. ✌
So long, partner.
